acceptedCommits.description: Explicit acceptance of these otherwise unchecked commits. Record with decision.py; merely mentioning a SHA in evidence is not acceptance.

question.description: The decision actually being made, as a question with more than one defensible answer.

options.description: The alternatives considered. One option is not a decision, it is a plan.

strongest_objection.description: The best case against this option, including the one that was chosen. An option with no objection was not examined.

rationale.description: Why this option beat the others. Long enough that a lazy output cannot satisfy it.

overturned_prior.description: True when this reverses what the orchestrator or a previous decision assumed. These are the ones a fresh context silently re-decides the other way.

frozen_by.description: The nodeId whose execution makes this irrevocable, or 'none'. For anything compiled into a genesis, re-deciding later is not an option.

evidence.description: What was run or read to establish this, not adjectives.
